title: Scalar KKL dichotomy
statement: Let $L,D,x,t\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $2\le 100L$, $2(D+2)\le 100L$, $x\ge 0$, and $t>0$. Then either $\frac{x}{100L e^x}\le \frac{t}{e^x}$ or $\frac{x}{100L e^x}\le t^{-2}e^{-Dt}$.
replaced: Let $L,D,x,t\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $2\le100L$, $2(D+2)\le100L$, $x\ge0$, and $t>0$. Then either $x/(100Le^x)\le t/e^x$ or $x/(100Le^x)\le t^{-2}e^{-Dt}$.
